task.title: Independently review the Echolet CLI prototype
task.description: Run a managed, flow-attached, path-scoped review of the complete CLI prototype using independent logic, backend/API, security, high-load/idempotency and testing reviewers, followed by finding verification and consolidation.
task.scope: apps/cli, relevant apps/relay code, and protocol/crypto/session packages used by the prototype

acceptance_criteria: The bounded path scope is generated by keryx review scope and saved with the managed review.
Independent reviewers cover logic/spec compliance, backend/API/persistence, security/data exposure, concurrency/idempotency and testing practices.
Every reviewer returns structured findings and checked-and-cleared hypotheses; no prose-only findings are accepted.
A separate review-verifier classifies all consolidated findings and preserves the required stage counts.
The final report contains exactly one keryx:findings block, explicit verdict and actionable evidence for every retained finding.
The managed review is attached to flow 001 and the required subagent-result is schema-valid.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet/.metaproject/index.md before any repository action and follow the local review-orchestrator skill.
This repository has an unborn main branch and untracked sources, so use explicit path mode and keryx review scope; never infer an empty git diff as an empty review.
Use managed attach-review mode for flow 001; there is no PR and no external comment publication step.
The user authorized autonomous orchestration: include the applicable testing convention reviewer without asking, and do not include unrelated frontend/MobX profiles.
Compute dispatch tiers and review budget with keryx commands; dispatch reviewer subagents independently and respect current concurrency.
Use keryx ctx for commands/logs and keryx ctx rg for every search; no bare rg or grep.
Review only: do not modify implementation, tests, flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Do not include plaintext, profile keys, private key material, ciphertext or request bodies in review artifacts.
Write a final report plus schema-valid subagent-result at the declared path; final first line STATUS:.

provenance.source_request: Implement the approved Echolet CLI prototype through flow-orchestrator.
